name: Kang-Petrov Arms KP-22 Sport 'Plinkmaster'
description:
The Kang-Petrov KP-22 Sport is a semi-automatic pistol chambered in .22 LR, designed for recreational target shooting with the ergonomics and controls of the full-size KP duty platform. The weapon is mechanically identical in layout to the KP-19 — same safety position, same magazine release, same slide lock — allowing owners to practice fundamentals on cheap .22 ammunition before transitioning to their carry weapon.

The KP-22 Sport features an extended five-inch barrel with a bull profile for maximum accuracy, adjustable target sights, and a match trigger tuned to break at 1.2kg. Kang-Petrov markets it as a 'training multiplier' — the idea that shooters who practice weekly with the Sport and shoot their duty weapon monthly will outperform shooters who practice monthly with their duty weapon exclusively.

The weapon has become standard equipment at security contractor training facilities, where recruits fire thousands of rounds through KP-22 Sports before ever touching their issued duty weapons. The cost savings are substantial — .22 LR ammunition costs a fraction of 9mm or .45 ACP — and the training transfer is measurable. Kang-Petrov's research division publishes annual data showing accuracy improvements in duty-weapon qualification scores for shooters who train primarily on the Sport.
specifications:
caliber: .22 LR
effective_range: 35 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 10 rounds
weight: 0.58 kg
tactical_use: No tactical application — this is a dedicated training and recreational weapon. Its value lies in providing a cost-effective platform for building and maintaining marksmanship fundamentals that transfer to duty-caliber weapons. The match trigger and accurate barrel reward proper technique and punish bad habits.
cultural_context: The Plinkmaster is the unsung hero of GLMZ's security industry. Thousands of security professionals maintain their edge by spending weekends at the range with a KP-22 Sport. In recreational shooting circles, it's the entry point for a lifetime hobby. Nobody brags about owning one, but almost everyone who shoots seriously has one.
story_hooks: A shooting instructor notices that one of their students is placing every round through the same hole at twenty-five meters — with a training pistol. The student's background doesn't explain that level of skill.

Kang-Petrov's training data is hacked and leaked, revealing the shooting proficiency scores of thousands of security contractors — information that reveals who the best and worst shooters in every security firm in GLMZ are.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, competition-oriented rimfire pistol with an elongated profile. The bull barrel dominates the silhouette, extending well forward of the slide in a distinctive tapered cylinder. The overall impression is purposeful and refined—clearly a tool for precision rather than combat. The frame sits low and balanced, with an aggressive forward rake to the grip.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 22.5 cm | Height: 13 cm | Width: 3.2 cm | Barrel length: 12.7 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and well-balanced. The bull barrel's mass is forward-biased, creating minimal muzzle rise during rapid fire. Feels almost delicate compared to duty-caliber platforms, yet substantial enough to inspire confidence.
physical_description.primary_material: Aluminum alloy frame with stainless steel slide and bull barrel
physical_description.finish: Matte stainless steel slide with a brushed aluminum frame. The barrel wears a polished stainless finish that catches light at the chamber. Minimal wear patterns on examples used for training.
physical_description.color_scheme: Silver and gunmetal gray with black polymer accents on the grip and safety lever
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured black polymer grip panels with lateral serrations. The backstrap features a subtle palm swell. Dry, professional feel—no rubberization, just engineered ergonomics.
distinctive_features: Extended bull barrel with prominent taper—the signature feature, clearly designed for sight radius and accuracy
Adjustable target rear sight on a dovetail mount, elevation and windage knobs with clear detent clicks
Undercut trigger guard for precision grip
Minimal slide serrations (top only) to reduce glint and weight
Ambidextrous safety lever in the same position as the KP-19 duty weapon
Magazine release paddle positioned identically to duty platform for muscle-memory transfer
Lightening cuts in the slide visible under side-lighting
No tactical rail or modern accessories—intentionally stripped for focus
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: KANG-PETROV ARMS stamped in crisp serif font on the left side of the slide. KP-22 SPORT engraved below in smaller text. Serial number on the right side. MADE IN GLMZ (Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone) stamp on the frame. A small Φ currency symbol discrete near the frame serial—indicating standard civilian pricing tier.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. Training weapons show fine scratches from holster draw practice and handling marks on the barrel from snap-cap drills. No corrosion. Slides may show light wear at the muzzle from thousands of loading cycles. Shooters maintain these religiously.
